main_text.l: DE NOMINUM FINIBVS. Von denen Endigungen der Namen oder Nennwörter.
Nomina substantiva propria virorum & Num. fingul. exeunt, in eigene Männer Namen Exempel, in singul. Num. wie sie sich im Italiänischen endigen, Als,
In A. Enea, Pitagora, Luca, idem Andrea, Porsena.
I. Parigi, Brindisi, Ragusi, Paris, Brundis, Ragusa.
O. Milano, Como, Pesaro, Meyland, Cemen, Pisauer.
V. Corju, Cefalu, Peru, Corfun, Cephallen, Perus.

page.notes: The left-margin vertical label reads "Nom. prop. Urbium / Viril. gener. terminantur in". Some Italian forms in the lists are partly illegible due to print quality and the italic type; the bracketed list grouping is reconstructed from the layout. The "Nomi" at lower right is a catchword.
